status: prospective supplement; publish before original experiment begins
purpose: Separate fixed input-depth orientation sensitivity from readout information loss using the original frozen heads and original caches; retain the original source/source/source primary result.
motivation: Pre-execution review showed that per-donor orientation requires composing normal_sign and runtime_reverse. The isolated runtime flag is misleading: the documented 9B and 814 legacy streams are both reversed relative to their stored ascending source order; 841 remains unverified. This supplement measures all combinations without asserting a known cross-donor mismatch.
unchanged: Reuse the exact original context exclusions, input arrays, scored label pixels, support mask, two frozen training-order heads and three readout definitions. No new downloads, backbone passes, contexts, fitting, model selection or new labels.
per_combination_procedure: Select one already frozen training-order head. Score its selected calibration-order cache, then recompute the same fixed calibration operating threshold independently for each arm. Apply the same head and threshold to the selected held-out test-order cache.
calibration_rule: For each arm, sort scored calibration background values descending and take background[floor(0.01*Nbackground)]. Prediction uses STRICT score>threshold. No background makes the threshold unassessable. No alternative FPR targets or tuning.
primary: source/source/source remains the sole original primary combination and must exactly reproduce the full original test metrics, including per-context results.
direction_interpretation: The original all-reversed combination remains its original sensitivity arm. All eight combinations are reported symmetrically and no cross-order combination is privileged. Historical runtime direction is not a verified physical ink face.
reporting: Report all eight combinations, all three arm validity states, per-context and pooled-parent calibration/test metrics, thresholds, hashes and execution costs. Keep invalid original fit arms invalid; never retry. Never choose or promote the best held-out combination.

budgets.expected_cost: Small CPU rescoring of existing central 32 by 32 pixel caches; no GPU required. Runtime measured, not promised.

limitations: This is a prospective sensitivity supplement, not a replacement of the original primary result.
The metadata direction is evidence about a historical runtime convention, not an independently verified physical ink face.
One held-out physical donor, model-assisted labels, historical label enrichment and unknown inherited Hecate exposure remain.
All eight combinations share the same tissue and frozen heads; they are not independent replications.
Orientation robustness does not establish transfer to native coarse acquisition, unread scrolls or readable letters.
No result here authorizes selecting a held-out winner, retraining or claiming a prize.
baseline_duplicates: For fixed calibration and test input orders, the baseline is identical across the two training-head orders. These duplicate rows complete the table and are not independent tests.
orientation_correction: A draft interpretation used runtime_reverse alone and incorrectly inferred opposite 9B/814 directions. Independent code review corrected that interpretation before publication or any CT access; the original experiment and all eight scoring combinations remain unchanged.
consistency_checks: Require the complete source/source/source and reverse/reverse/reverse test metrics to exactly reproduce their original results. Verify identical label IDs, labels and context order across cached input directions. Record reused feature-file hashes.
